```{r load_library, include=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(here)
```

# Configuration

```{r setup}
# File's path (change if necessary)
file_path <- here("Spreadsheets", "Metiloma_CP_PlanilhaINCA.xlsx") # The order is Folder name + File name
selected_col <- "Estadiamento" # Choose what column you want selected
chip_cols <- 6 # How many columns will your chip have?
chip_rows <- 8 # How many rows will your chip have?
n_chips <- 1 # How many chips will you need?
cleaning_staging_column <- TRUE
cleaning_sex_column <- FALSE
spots_per_chip <- chip_rows * chip_cols
total_samples <- nrow(Data)
num_of_chips_needed <- ceiling(total_samples / spots_per_chip)
empty_spots <- (num_of_chips_needed * spots_per_chip) - total_samples

# Uncomment these lines if you want these informations in your doc
# print(paste("Total amount of samples:", total_samples))
# print(paste("Spots per chip:", spots_per_chip))
print(paste("The randomization will consider ", num_of_chips_needed,"chips"))

print(paste("!!!WARNING!!! Your last chip will have", empty_spots, "empty spots"))


```

# Data Loading
```{r data_loading}
loaded_data <- read_excel(file_path)

```


# Data Wrangling
```{r data_wrangling}
for selected_col[i] {
  if selected_col[i] !%in% colnames(file_path){
    print("!!!WARNING!!! the selected column does not exist!")
  } else if {
    class(file_path[,selected_col[i]]) %in% c(is.factor(class), is.character(class) )
  }
}
```
# Randomization Algorithm

```{r randomization}
set.seed(123)

```
